text: 证监会发布关于彤程新材料集团股份有限公司境外发行上市备案通知书，公司拟发行不超过78,724,900股境外上市普通股并在香港联合交易所上市。
text_en: The CSRC issued a filing notice for Red Avenue New Materials Group Co., Ltd.'s overseas issuance and listing, with the company planning to issue no more than 78,724,900 overseas listed ordinary shares and list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
